evidence.title: How Europe can better protect against extreme wildfires

occurrences.checkable_against: PIK study projections of annual European burned area under stronger climate action
occurrences.quote_span: The researchers found that even with significantly stronger climate action, 39% more land could be burning annually by the end of the century than it is today.
occurrences.speaker: Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research
occurrences.subject: Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research

occurrences.checkable_against: PIK study published in Global Change Biology on European wildfire risk
occurrences.quote_span: And according to a study published today by the Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research (PIK), the coming decades are likely to see the wildfire risk in Europe worsen.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research

occurrences.checkable_against: PIK study projections of annual European burned area
occurrences.quote_span: Annual burned area could triple
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research

occurrences.checkable_against: The linked 2025 article's cited European wildfire-risk projection and climate-impact research
occurrences.quote_span: Wildfires in Europe are becoming more severe. With climate change intensifying droughts and reducing summer rain, wildfire risk is predicted to more than double by 2100.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research

occurrences.checkable_against: PIK study projection of future burned areas under rapid emissions cuts and effective fire management

figure.unit: percent reduction in future burned areas

occurrences.quote_span: If the greenhouse gas emissions generated by burning fossil fuels to power our homes and industries were to fall rapidly and sharply limit global warming , effective fire management could reduce future burned areas by as much as 90%.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research

occurrences.checkable_against: Published statement by Kirsten Thonicke and the cited PIK study
occurrences.quote_span: "Climate change could create conditions so extreme that we reach the limits of what is still feasible in preventing and fighting fires once they grow beyond a certain size," said Kirsten Thonicke of PIK, a co-author of the study.
occurrences.speaker: Kirsten Thonicke
occurrences.subject: Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research

occurrences.checkable_against: Paris Agreement text and official international climate commitments
occurrences.quote_span: The international community originally agreed to limit global warming to 1.5 degrees Celsius , or at least to well below 2C .
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research

occurrences.checkable_against: Published statement by Thomas Hickler on wildfire management measures
occurrences.quote_span: Wildfire management, improved training and equipment for emergency responders, as well as stronger coordination between forestry authorities , conservation bodies and fire services can "make a substantial difference," according to Hickler.
occurrences.speaker: Thomas Hickler
occurrences.subject: Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research

occurrences.checkable_against: PIK study data on European burned area during the 2026 heatwave season
occurrences.quote_span: According to the study, by early August, twice as much land had already burned in Europe during this summer's heatwave season than in recent years.
occurrences.speaker: Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research
occurrences.subject: Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research

occurrences.checkable_against: Global Change Biology study led by Maik Billing on European wildfire frequency projections
occurrences.quote_span: "If we continue to produce more emissions and global temperatures rise by around 3.6 degrees Celsius (6.48 Fahrenheit), wildfires will become much more frequent, especially in the Mediterranean region and across large parts of western and central Europe, including areas that have experienced few fires so far," said PIK researcher Maik Billing, lead author of the study published in the scientific journal Global Change Biology.
occurrences.speaker: Maik Billing
occurrences.subject: Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research

occurrences.checkable_against: Published statement by Thomas Hickler on increasing fire-conducive conditions and investment
occurrences.quote_span: "We see fire-conducive conditions increasing, so we need to invest more," he said.
occurrences.speaker: Thomas Hickler
occurrences.subject: Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research

occurrences.checkable_against: PIK study conclusions on climate action and long-term wildfire control
occurrences.quote_span: However, the study argues that significantly stronger climate action will still be necessary if wildfires are to remain under control in the long term.
occurrences.speaker: Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research
occurrences.subject: Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research

occurrences.checkable_against: National climate targets and emissions-progress assessments
occurrences.quote_span: However, countries are still falling far short on their climate targets.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research
